## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm quality` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (network-free)
- [ ] Changeset added for any published-package change (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] SemVer impact considered (public surface additive unless the changeset says otherwise)
- [ ] No secrets, live API keys, or customer payloads in the diff or screenshots
